commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Lord Xander, the Collector ({4}{U}{B}{R} legendary Vampire Demon Noble 6/6; Streets of New Capenna, snc, released 2022-04-29; oracle_id d17bfa94-5046-46ae-80af-be5d1d35af13). Commander-legal per live Scryfall, not a Game Changer, released, no project exception. Oracle: when it enters, target opponent discards half their hand (rounded down); whenever it attacks, defending player mills half their library; when it dies, target opponent sacrifices half their nonland permanents. Plan (owner 2026-10-14): Xander trigger multiplication. Reanimate or copy the seven-mana commander (Animate Dead, Reanimate, Feign Death, Entomb; Auton Soldier, Phantasmal Image, Spark Double, Sakashima, Helm of the Host, Blade of Selves, Molten Duplication, Saw in Half, Hall of Echoes; Roaming Throne, Strionic Resonator), then convert the half-library mill (Bruvac, Fraying Sanity, Riverchurn Monument, Cruel Calculations). All three adds serve exactly that: Necromancy reanimates the legendary commander, Boots protects him without blocking the deck's own targeting, and Malakir Rebirth turns a death into a dies-plus-enters pair.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized; owner-approved, registry ceiling 4), unchanged. Game Changers: 20 in both baseline and candidate; none of the adds is a Game Changer. Commander Spellbook: 11 included combos in baseline and candidate (almost-included 132 -> 131); no combo is added or lost.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Xander's Oracle: each add exists to return, protect or re-trigger the commander. No generic Oracle/Consultation package, no additive mill (owner-rejected class: Fractured Sanity, Ruin Crab, Syr Konrad, Traumatize and others), no further clone (owner-rejected Phyrexian Metamorph, Irenicus's Vile Duplication; Glasspool Mimic rejected for that reason), no Panharmonicon, Displacer Kitten, Deadeye Navigator, Jidoor or Kitsune's Technique, and no owner-removed card (Grindstone, Painter's Servant, Narset, Parter of Veils, Reliquary Tower) is added. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the registry Archidekt exports, candidate/baseline, of 94 nonbasic names): Cormela, Glamour Thief 52/52; Kess, Dissident Mage 52/52; Kefka, Court Mage 51/51; Mai and Zuko 49/51; Gwendlyn Di Corci 48/50 (the last two also run Lightning Greaves and Bojuka Bog, so the swaps slightly reduce overlap with them). The overlap is the Grixis mana base and staples (fast mana, free counters, tutors). Xander-specific against the five closest in the candidate: the copy package (Auton Soldier, Spark Double, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, Helm of the Host, Blade of Selves, Hall of Echoes), the mill conversions (Bruvac the Grandiloquent, Fraying Sanity, Riverchurn Monument, Maddening Cacophony, Cruel Calculations) and the dies-trigger tools (Altar of Dementia, Feign Death, Malakir Rebirth). Across all registry exports, Necromancy appears in 4 decks, Swiftfoot Boots in 14 and Malakir Rebirth in none; the cuts appear in 2 (Persist), 32 (Lightning Greaves) and 14 (Bojuka Bog).

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 library cards were reviewed (93 single rows plus 2 Island, 2 Swamp, 2 Mountain; 96 distinct names). Owner 2026-10-14 adds: Auton Soldier, Phantasmal Image, Cruel Calculations, Hall of Echoes (replacing Grindstone, Painter's Servant, Narset, Parter of Veils, Reliquary Tower). The whole-list audit CSV marks all 100 KEEP_AFTER_WHOLE_LIST_AUDIT generically; the decisions file names the explicit keeps (reanimation axis including Persist, the trigger multipliers, the mill conversions, the secondary closes and the challenged staples). Persist is the one explicit keep cut (FLAGGED); Lightning Greaves and Bojuka Bog are not named. Candidate roles: reanimation Necromancy, Animate Dead, Reanimate, Entomb, Feign Death, Malakir Rebirth; copies Auton Soldier, Phantasmal Image, Spark Double, Sakashima, Helm of the Host, Blade of Selves, Molten Duplication, Saw in Half, Hall of Echoes; trigger doublers Roaming Throne, Strionic Resonator; mill conversion Bruvac, Fraying Sanity, Riverchurn Monument, Cruel Calculations; protection Swiftfoot Boots and the counter suite; secondary closes Duskmantle Guildmage + Mindcrank, Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond + Brain Freeze, Aggravated Assault + Sword of Feast and Famine.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Land slots 33 -> 33: the candidate has 32 lands plus the Malakir Rebirth // Malakir Mire MDFC (Bojuka Bog out); basics 2 Island, 2 Swamp, 2 Mountain. Nonland curve (front faces; Malakir counted at MV1): MV0 3, MV1 14 -> 15, MV2 23 -> 22, MV3 15 -> 16, MV4 7, MV5 3, MV6 1; average nonland MV 2.33 unchanged. Coloured pips U/B/R in the library 27/18/9 -> 27/19/9. Coloured land sources (dedicated lands, Prismatic Vista counted for all three) U/B/R 18/20/18 -> 18/19/18, plus Malakir Mire as a B source when played as a land. Bounded goldfish (seed 30, 20000 games): P(Xander cast) by turn 7 0.3779 unchanged; P(Xander attack trigger) turn 6 0.1924 -> 0.1857, turn 7 0.2978 -> 0.2897 (all from the Boots equip cost). Hypergeometric P(2-4 land slots in the opening 7 of 99 with 33) 0.7069.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Swan Song, An Offer You Can't Refuse and the rest of the counter suite. Board: Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp and the removal suite; Xander's dies trigger is itself removal. The candidate keeps Xander hexproof (Boots) without blocking the deck's own tricks, and adds two ways to turn his death into value (Necromancy end-step line, Malakir Rebirth). Loses Bojuka Bog, the only maindeck graveyard exile: weaker to opposing reanimation and Breach mirrors.

material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Persist is an EXPLICIT owner keep (2026-10-14 decisions: 'Feign Death, Animate Dead, Persist, Reanimate, and Entomb retain the reanimation axis that makes a seven-mana commander realistic'). {1}{B} sorcery: return target NONLEGENDARY creature card from your graveyard with a -1/-1 counter. material_candidates.commander_synergy: Returns the legendary commander itself (enters trigger: half-hand discard), or an opponent's milled creature. Cast at an opponent's end step: Xander enters (discard), Necromancy is sacrificed at cleanup and takes Xander with it, so his dies trigger (half nonland permanents) also fires. Grid B1 (36 cells): returns in 12 versus Persist 4; 10 cells Necromancy-only, 2 Persist-only; 1 extra dies trigger.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: One more mana than Persist ({2}{B} versus {1}{B}); loses the Persist-only cells where exactly two mana is available (2/36). The end-step line leaves nothing on board. Low adoption: upgraded 14/256 only. Overrides an explicit owner keep, so it is FLAGGED and an owner-keeping alternative 100 is staged.
material_candidates.reason: Genuine swap 1 (FLAGGED owner-keep override): Pass C's top-priority test; clear rules evidence that Persist cannot do the job the owner kept it for (return Xander), and Necromancy also adds a dies trigger. Owner-keeping alternatives A and B are complete 100s.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: Three swaps: a recursion spell that can return the legendary commander (and add a dies trigger) replaces one that cannot; haste/hexproof equipment that lets the deck still target its own commander replaces shroud equipment; and an MDFC dies-return trick replaces a graveyard-hate land. Cost: one more mana for the recursion, equip {1} instead of {0} (P(Xander attack trigger) turn 7 0.2978 -> 0.2897), and the loss of the only maindeck graveyard exile. Game Changers stay at 20; land slots 33; Spellbook 11 included; Bracket 4. Persist is an explicit owner keep (FLAGGED); owner-keeping alternatives A and B are staged.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: SELECTED research candidate (three genuine swaps). Each swap is independent; the Necromancy half overrides the explicit owner keep Persist and is FLAGGED, with complete owner-keeping alternatives staged.
Alt A (staged complete 100): keeps every owner keep and owner add, including Persist; Necromancy replaces Karlach, Fury of Avernus (the extra-combat close is lost).
Alt B (staged complete 100): keeps every owner keep and owner add; Necromancy replaces An Offer You Can't Refuse (one cheap counter is lost).
Pass C Goryo's Vengeance package (staged complete 100). NOT COUNTED: hasty but exiled at end step; narrower than Necromancy in grid B1.
Kiki-Jiki package (staged complete 100). NOT COUNTED: strong Xander multiplier but adds three commander-independent infinites (Spellbook 11 -> 14).

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C requested Necromancy against Persist and a comparison with Goryo's Vengeance; Goryo's is staged as a complete 100. Because Persist is an explicit owner keep, Necromancy is also staged against Karlach, Fury of Avernus (alt A) and An Offer You Can't Refuse (alt B), each a complete 100 keeping every owner keep and add.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The owner kept Persist to reanimate a seven-mana commander, but Persist cannot target a legendary card; and Lightning Greaves' shroud blocks the deck's own equips and targeted death/copy tricks on Xander. Both are rules mismatches with the owner's stated plan.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Three genuine swaps: +Necromancy -Persist (FLAGGED owner-keep override, rules-driven), +Swiftfoot Boots -Lightning Greaves (rules-driven, haste cost disclosed) and +Malakir Rebirth // Malakir Mire -Bojuka Bog (weakest, tie disclosed). Pass C's comparison was run: Goryo's Vengeance is staged, Seize the Day rejected. Every other challenger is dominated, owner-rejected, generic, marginal or invalid. RESEARCH_ONLY.

The sealed evidence and the checker are not edited; a valid J bundle cannot be produced honestly. (2) Only three genuine swaps (+Necromancy -Persist, FLAGGED owner-keep override; +Swiftfoot Boots -Lightning Greaves; +Malakir Rebirth // Malakir Mire -Bojuka Bog), below the five-swap owner-presentation floor; the rest are dominated, owner-rejected, generic, marginal or invalid.
